'''Star Tours Flight 1027''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1J at 1420 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1515.
